text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo, whose debut was once in doubt, 
somehow makes it to the opening season of 
the Classic Triple Crown with the help of 
her friends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she still has a weakness. She 
runs out of breath mid-race and loses all 
her stamina. Winning the Classic Triple 
Crown will be tough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To grow stronger, they head for Fukushima. 
Fukushima Racecourse features tight turns 
and a short final straight. It suits her 
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the GIII Radio NIKKEI 
Sho. I'll get stronger and return to the 
big stage.
